content: Next, the never look back property implies that once we have moved away from a field we are unlikely to pay attention to it again. For example, once we have rendered all the occupations in the generated description there is no need to return back to the occupation field. In other words, once we have moved on ( INLINEFORM0 ), we want the successive field context vectors INLINEFORM1 to be very different from the previous field vectors INLINEFORM2 . One way of ensuring this is to orthogonalize successive field vectors using DISPLAYFORM0
